notes.title: Game Lens v0.68
notes.content:
[b]Game Lens – Patch Notes (v0.68)[/b]
[list]
[b]Release date:[/b] 2025-08-24
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.68
[/list]
[quote][b]We need your help testing![/b]
Please report any issues in our [url=https://discord.gg/bFCtMKUADc]Discord[/url]. There’s a dedicated [b]Discord[/b] button at the bottom of the left sidebar in the app—click it to join the channel.[/quote]
[h2]✨ Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[b]Smooth show/hide[/b] – Native window opacity fade‑in/out with adjustable duration and easing.
[b]Push hotkey delay[/b] – Hold to show; hide after release with a configurable delay ([b]0–10000 ms[/b]).
[b]Zoom presets[/b] – Bind keys to fixed zoom levels (×1–×16) for instant switching.
[b]Color presets & Invert[/b] – Invert moved into presets; save/delete custom color presets available globally.
[/list]
[h2]➤ Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[b]Safer defaults[/b] – Color correction is [b]OFF[/b] by default; preset is [b]None[/b]; Smooth show/hide is [b]OFF[/b].
[b]Hotkey tab order[/b] – Clear structure: Toggle → Push → Zoom hotkeys → Zoom presets → Sensitivity.
[b]Localization[/b] – All new labels and controls use in‑app localization.
[b]Persistence[/b] – All new settings (push delay, fade options, zoom presets, color presets/invert) save and load with profiles.
[/list]
[h2]➤ Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[b]Fade flicker[/b] – Reworked to animate only window opacity; no blinking or half‑opacity states.
[b]Push delay stability[/b] – Delay now applies immediately on change; only defers hiding (no side‑effects). Fixed image “sliding” inside the lens when delay > 0 ms.
[b]Hidden mode[/b] – User preference is respected across show/hide; no unintended resets.
[/list]
[h2]➤ Security/Compliance Notes[/h2]
[list]
No drivers, no admin rights, no low‑level hooks.
All user data is stored only in [tt]%APPDATA%\\Game Lens[/tt].
“Risky” modes apply only when explicitly enabled by the user.
[/list]
[i]Thanks for helping us test! If anything misbehaves, click the bottom [b]Discord[/b] button in the app and let us know in the channel.[/i]

notes.title: Game Lens v0.67
notes.content:
[b]Game Lens – Patch Notes (v0.67)[/b]
[list]
[b]Release date:[/b] 2025-08-21
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.67
[/list]

[h2]✨ Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[b]System-Tray Mode[/b] – Run Game Lens directly from the Windows tray with ON/OFF/Safe-Mode indicators and quick toggles.  
[b]Quick Setup Gestures[/b] – One master switch to enable drag, resize, and capture gestures with instant overlays.  
[b]Crosshair Preview Widget[/b] – Real-time 128×128 preview of your crosshair with all parameters applied.  
[b]Automatic Startup[/b] – Option to launch Game Lens with Windows.  
[b]Global UI Font Control[/b] – Adjust the app’s font size (6–18 pt) with live updates.  
[/list]

[h2]➤ New Features[/h2]
[list]
[b]Tray Menu Actions[/b] – Hide/Show Settings or Magnifier, toggle Safe-Mode, and switch Profiles directly from the tray.  
[b]Drag & Resize Gestures[/b] – Ctrl+LMB to move the lens, Ctrl+RMB to drag capture area, Shift+LMB to resize with clear violet overlays.  
[b]Shift+Wheel Zoom[/b] – Zoom anywhere on screen while holding Shift, with live zoom hint overlay.  
[b]Quick Toggles in Header[/b] – Instant ON/OFF switches for Magnifier and Safe-Mode without opening tabs.  
[b]Clear Hotkey Buttons[/b] – Easily remove assigned shortcuts with one click.  
[b]Language Restart Dialog[/b] – Option to restart now or later when changing app language.  
[/list]

[h2]➤ UI/UX Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[b]Quick Setup Group[/b] – Added in Capture tab with inline hotkey hints and synced header toggle.  
[b]Gesture Visuals[/b] – Unified violet overlays ([tt]#a259ff[/tt] preview, [tt]#d4b3ff[/tt] active).  
[b]Crosshair & Appearance[/b] – Clear sections, dynamic hiding of unused controls, instant preview updates.  
[b]Capture Tab[/b] – Reorganized into Basics, Positioning, and Size groups.  
[b]Dark Theme Pass[/b] – Better contrast for combo-boxes, tabs, buttons, and dialogs.  
[b]Safe Mode UX[/b] – Disabled widgets are dimmed with explanatory tooltips.  
[b]Dynamic Labels[/b] – Buttons automatically swap text (Hide/Show) depending on state.  
[b]Unified Fonts[/b] – Global size/scale applied consistently across all dialogs and tabs.  
[/list]

[h2]➤ Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[b]Language Switching[/b] – No more duplicate magnifier windows or tray icons.  
[b]DPI Scaling[/b] – Fixed drag offset issues on high-DPI displays (e.g., 175% on 4K).  
[b]Startup Stability[/b] – Fixed crashes from missing gesture methods or class errors.  
[b]Hotkey Handling[/b] – Prevents duplicates, adds clear buttons, and restores Shift+Wheel zoom.  
[b]Theme Switching[/b] – UI widgets now refresh instantly without restart.  
[b]FPS Graph[/b] – Improved visibility in dark theme with proper violet/gray axis colors.  
[b]Guide Lines[/b] – Capture overlay disappears immediately after releasing hotkey.  
[b]General Stability[/b] – Cleaner startup, reduced warnings, consistent group borders.  
[/list]

[h2]➤ Notes[/h2]
[list]
Tray icons scale from 16–128 px for sharp rendering at any DPI.  
Autostart entries appear in Task Manager → Startup as “Game Lens” with proper icon.  
Gesture overlays remain lightweight and click-through.  
All new strings are translated – English is used if a language is missing.  
[/list]

[i]Game Lens v0.67 introduces tray mode, gesture-based controls, crosshair preview, and many UI improvements for a smoother, more customizable experience. Thank you for your feedback – it drives every update![/i]

notes.title: Game Lens v0.66.2
notes.content:
[b]Game Lens – Patch Notes (v0.66.2)[/b]
[list]
[b]Release date:[/b] 2025-07-05
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.66.2
[/list]

[h2]➤ New Features[/h2]
[list]

[b]Overlay Blocker[/b] – New switch added to [i]Settings ▸ Theme[/i]: “Block external overlays”.  
 • Prevents 3rd-party overlays (Discord, Steam, GeForce Experience, etc.) from covering the lens or settings panel.  
 • Enabled by default; can be disabled for troubleshooting.

[b]Portable Profile Storage[/b] – Profiles are now saved to a single [u]magnifier_config.json[/u] in the Game Lens folder (instead of AppData).  
 • Easier to back up, sync, or transfer between PCs.
[/list]

[h2]➤ Quality-of-Life Updates[/h2]
[list]
Default “Always-on-Top” states: Magnifier = ON, Settings window = OFF.  
Profiles now remember top-most and overlay-blocker preferences.  
Hotkey system now logs duplicate bindings only once.
[/list]

[h2]➤ Fixes[/h2]
[list]
Fixed crash when adjusting mouse sensitivity without cache value.  
Eliminated rare warning when disconnecting the diameter-link signal.  
Suppressed false “Failed to update mouse sensitivity” errors.  
[/list]

[h2]➤ Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
Qt font warnings (“OpenType support missing…”) are harmless and can be ignored.  
If theme loading fails on Windows 10, ensure [u]assets/style_dark_esports.qss[/u] is present and accessible – a fallback will load automatically in most cases.
[/list]

[i]Thank you for supporting Game Lens! Your feedback keeps the project moving forward.[/i]

notes.title: Game Lens v0.66.1
notes.content:
[b]Game Lens – Patch Notes (v0.66.1)[/b]
[list]
[b]Release date:[/b] 2025-07-03
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.66.1
[/list]
[h2]➤ New Features[/h2]
[list]
[b]Magnifier On/Off Toggle[/b] – A dedicated switch is now placed at the bottom of the [i]Capture[/i] tab.
 • It mirrors the Hotkey state, so changing either control keeps the other in-sync.
[b]Zoom Hint Overlay[/b] – Enable the new “Show Zoom Hint” toggle (in [i]Appearance[/i]) to briefly display the current magnification (e.g. ×4) inside the lens for 2 seconds after every zoom change.
[b]Light UI Theme[/b] – A full light-mode stylesheet can be enabled from the new “[i]Theme[/i]” tab inside [i]Settings[/i].
[/list]
[h2]➤ Concentration Mode Improvements[/h2]
[list]
The concentration shadow (cut-out “hole”) is now cached and redrawn only when its parameters actually change.
 • Reduces CPU load; no more per-frame updates.
Removed unnecessary “Move Hole” controls – the hole remains centred, simplifying the UI.
[/list]
[h2]➤ Quality-of-Life & UI Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
All sliders (opacity, colour correction, etc.) are twice as long for finer control.
Crosshair-arm buttons resized and fully left-aligned for a cleaner layout.
Settings page rebuilt with proper tabs (Hotkey / Language / Theme) and a persistent “[b]Settings[/b]” header.
Help page tightened: wrapped text and equal-width buttons (Discord, YouTube, X(Twitter), ReadMe, Diagnostics).
Control panel can now be narrowed down to ~240 px – no more forced ultra-wide minimum width.
[/list]
[h2]➤ Diagnostics & Hotkeys[/h2]
[list]
[b]Improved Diagnostics[/b] – “Copy Diagnostics” now collects more system details and recent log lines in a tidy Markdown block.
[b]Non-Blocking Hotkeys[/b] – Registering a single key (e.g. CapsLock) no longer prevents that key from functioning normally in other applications.
[/list]
[h2]➤ Fixes[/h2]
[list]
Fixed sliders ignoring maximum-width settings on certain DPI-scales.
Safe Mode correctly disables colour-correction sliders again.
Minor localisation touch-ups.
[/list]
[i]Thank you for using Game Lens! Your feedback drives every update – keep it coming.[/i]
